activity.notes: After Æthelred's death in 911, Æthelflæd governed Mercia in her own right until her death in 918. Her historical title is preserved rather than normalizing her into a later-style queen.

sources.title: Edward 'The Elder' (r.899-924) — The Royal Family
sources.citation_text: The Royal Family states that Æthelflæd governed Mercia after her husband's death.

sources.title: Stowe Ch 22 — British Library
sources.citation_text: The British Library catalogue identifies Æthelred (d.911) and Æthelflæd (d.918) as rulers of the Mercians.
